P0100.fix: Check the MAF connector/wiring; clean or replace the MAF sensor.

P0101.fix: Clean the MAF with MAF-safe spray; check the air filter and intake boot.

P0102.fix: Inspect for intake leaks after the MAF; check wiring; replace the MAF.

P0103.fix: Check the MAF wiring/connector; replace the MAF if out of range.

P0106.fix: Check the MAP sensor and its vacuum line; replace if reading is off.

P0107.fix: Inspect MAP wiring/connector; replace the MAP sensor.

P0108.fix: Check the MAP vacuum line and wiring; replace the MAP sensor.

P0111.fix: Inspect/replace the IAT sensor; check the connector.

P0112.fix: Check IAT wiring for a short; replace the sensor.

P0113.fix: Inspect the IAT sensor and wiring; replace the sensor if faulty.

P0116.fix: Check coolant level; inspect/replace the ECT sensor.

P0117.fix: Check ECT wiring for a short; replace the sensor.

P0118.fix: Inspect the ECT connector/wiring; replace the sensor.

P0121.fix: Clean the throttle body; check the TPS; inspect wiring.

P0122.meaning: Throttle/pedal position sensor A low input
P0122.fix: Check TPS wiring/connector; replace the throttle position sensor.

P0123.meaning: Throttle/pedal position sensor A high input
P0123.fix: Check TPS wiring for a short to power; replace the TPS.

P0128.fix: Usually a stuck-open thermostat; replace it.

P0130.fix: Inspect the upstream O2 sensor and wiring; replace the sensor.

P0131.fix: Check for an exhaust leak and O2 wiring; replace the upstream O2 sensor.

P0132.fix: Check for a rich condition; inspect O2 wiring; replace the sensor.

P0133.fix: The upstream O2 sensor is aging; replace it.

P0134.fix: Check O2 heater/wiring; replace the upstream O2 sensor.

P0135.fix: Check the O2 heater fuse and wiring; usually replace the O2 sensor.

P0136.fix: Inspect the downstream O2 sensor and wiring; replace the sensor.

P0137.fix: Check for an exhaust leak; inspect wiring; replace the downstream O2.

P0138.fix: Inspect O2 wiring; replace the downstream O2 sensor.

P0141.fix: Check the downstream O2 heater circuit; usually replace the O2 sensor.

P0150.fix: Bank 2 equivalent of P0130; inspect/replace the upstream O2 sensor.

P0151.fix: Check for an exhaust leak and wiring; replace the O2 sensor.

P0155.fix: Check the O2 heater circuit; replace the bank-2 upstream O2 sensor.

P0161.fix: Check the O2 heater circuit; replace the bank-2 downstream O2 sensor.

P0171.fix: Look for vacuum/intake leaks, a dirty MAF sensor, or weak fuel pump.

P0172.fix: Check for a leaking injector, high fuel pressure, or a dirty MAF/O2 sensor.

P0173.fix: Diagnose like lean/rich on bank 2: leaks, MAF, fuel pressure.

P0174.fix: Same as P0171 but bank 2: vacuum leaks, MAF, fuel delivery.

P0175.fix: Bank 2 equivalent of P0172: leaking injector, fuel pressure, MAF/O2.

P0201.fix: Check injector 1 wiring/connector and resistance; replace if open/shorted.

P0202.fix: Check injector 2 wiring/resistance; replace if faulty.

P0203.fix: Check injector 3 wiring/resistance; replace if faulty.

P0204.fix: Check injector 4 wiring/resistance; replace if faulty.

P0217.fix: Stop and let it cool. Check coolant, thermostat, water pump, radiator/fans.

P0219.fix: Avoid over-revving; check for a downshift/throttle fault if unexpected.

P0300.fix: Check spark plugs, coils, and fuel delivery; look for vacuum leaks.

P0301.fix: Swap the coil/plug for cyl 1 with a neighbour; if the misfire moves, that part is bad. Also check that injector and compression.

P0302.fix: Swap the coil/plug with a neighbour to isolate; check injector/compression.

P0303.fix: Swap the coil/plug with a neighbour to isolate; check injector/compression.

P0304.fix: Swap the coil/plug with a neighbour to isolate; check injector/compression.

P0305.fix: Swap the coil/plug with a neighbour to isolate; check injector/compression.

P0306.fix: Swap the coil/plug with a neighbour to isolate; check injector/compression.

P0307.fix: Swap the coil/plug with a neighbour to isolate; check injector/compression.

P0308.fix: Swap the coil/plug with a neighbour to isolate; check injector/compression.

P0313.fix: Refuel - misfires can set when the tank is nearly empty.

P0316.fix: Check plugs/coils and fuel pressure at cold start.

P0325.fix: Inspect the knock sensor connector/wiring; replace the sensor if open/shorted.

P0330.fix: Inspect the bank-2 knock sensor and wiring; replace if faulty.

P0335.fix: Check the crank sensor and wiring; replace the sensor (common no-start).

P0336.fix: Inspect the reluctor/tone ring and crank sensor gap; replace the sensor.

P0340.fix: Check the cam sensor and wiring; replace the sensor; verify timing.

P0341.fix: Check cam/crank correlation and timing; inspect the cam sensor.

P0401.fix: Clean the EGR valve and passages; check the EGR vacuum/electrical control.

P0402.fix: Check for a stuck-open EGR valve or a blocked DPFE/pressure sensor line.

P0404.fix: Inspect the EGR valve position sensor and wiring; clean/replace the valve.

P0411.fix: Check the air pump, hoses and check valves for the smog/air system.

P0420.fix: Often a failing catalytic converter or an O2 sensor; verify the O2 first.

P0430.fix: Bank 2 equivalent of P0420; verify the rear O2 sensor before the cat.

P0440.fix: Check the gas cap and EVAP hoses; a smoke test finds the leak.

P0441.fix: Inspect the purge valve and hoses; replace a stuck purge valve.

P0442.fix: Reseat/replace the gas cap; inspect EVAP lines for small cracks.

P0443.fix: Check the purge valve wiring/connector; replace the purge valve.

P0446.fix: Inspect the vent valve (often clogged with debris) and its wiring.

P0455.fix: Check the gas cap first (reseat/replace), then EVAP hoses and valves.

P0456.fix: Usually the gas cap seal or a tiny hose crack; smoke-test the EVAP system.

P0457.fix: Tighten or replace the fuel cap, then clear the code.

P0500.fix: Check the VSS and wiring; replace the speed sensor.

P0505.fix: Clean the throttle body and idle air control valve; check for vacuum leaks.

P0506.fix: Check for a dirty throttle body, vacuum leak, or IAC fault.

P0507.fix: Look for a vacuum leak or a stuck-open IAC/throttle plate.

P0520.fix: Check oil level first; inspect the oil pressure sensor and wiring.

P0562.fix: Test the battery and alternator; a weak battery or charging fault is common.

P0563.fix: Check the alternator/voltage regulator for overcharging.

P0601.meaning: Internal control module memory checksum error
P0601.fix: A PCM/ECM fault; reflash or replace the module (shop/dealer).

P0606.fix: Check module power/grounds; the ECM/PCM may need replacement.

P0700.fix: A transmission code is stored; read the TCM sub-codes with a capable scanner.

P0705.fix: Check/adjust the neutral safety/range switch; inspect its wiring.

P0715.fix: Inspect the transmission input speed sensor and wiring.

P0720.fix: Inspect the transmission output speed sensor and wiring.

P0730.fix: Check transmission fluid level/condition; a shift/clutch fault - see a shop.

P0740.fix: Check the TCC solenoid and fluid; a converter/solenoid fault.

P0750.fix: Inspect the shift solenoid and wiring; check fluid condition.

U0100.fix: Check ECU power/ground and the CAN bus wiring/connectors.

U0101.fix: Check the transmission module's power, grounds and CAN wiring.

U0121.fix: Check the ABS module connector, power/ground and CAN bus.
